No user-visible changes in this version.

- Version bump only; no file changes detected.

AgentEpstein 1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Harvests image datasets from major art sites (Danbooru, yande.re, e621, Safebooru, Konachan, Gelbooru, X, and Pixiv) for LoRA or fine-tune training.
- Uses plain HTTP or a real browser for scraping, bypassing bot walls and supporting login-protected sites.
- Verifies candidates on X and Pixiv visually, keeping full provenance (artist/page/tag) on each image.
- Supports dataset collection by tag, artist, ship, or fandom, and includes mechanisms to handle loosely-tagged sites like X and Pixiv.
- Designed for easy dataset or reference set creation even when sites block automated tools.
